html:
SMTO-SKL-0033 — No Google account is connected for Google Drive

GUID: 593b059a-3114-526a-970e-21cc818c02b7
Slug: google-drive-account-missing
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: google-drive

What happened

  • SMTO doesn't have a Google account it can use for Google Drive yet, so it couldn't do what you asked. Nothing in your Drive was touched.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In a conversation, ask SMTO: "Connect my Google account for Google Drive." Approve the request when SMTO asks. Drive actions need a Google account that you have connected and approved.
  2. Open the Google sign-in link SMTO gives you, sign in with the account that holds your files, and allow the access shown. Google only lets SMTO into your Drive after you agree on Google's own page.
  3. If SMTO says the Google app setup is missing, ask the person who manages SMTO to add the Google sign-in app details in Parameter Store. Connecting any Google account depends on that one-time setup, which only an administrator can provide.

What success looks like

  • Asking SMTO which Google accounts are connected shows your account, and your Drive request works.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't paste your Google password or any codes from Google into the conversation.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Drive account resolution found no eligible google_account (or the linked google_oauth_app profile is missing), so no Drive request was sent.

What this means

  • Drive account resolution finds no eligible shared Google account or a missing linked OAuth app. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Drive account resolution finds no eligible shared Google account or a missing linked OAuth app.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect exact account_ref and linked shared OAuth profile.

How to fix it

  • resolve_account (auth/google/accounts.py) found no google_account with the required Drive feature, or the account's google_oauth_app is missing (mapped to account_missing). Ensure a google_oauth_app profile exists in Parameter Store, then connect a shared google_account with google_drive.connect or auth.google_connect requesting the needed Drive features.
  • Connect a shared google_account using google_drive.connect or auth.google_connect.

Retry and execution caution

  • Connect a shared google_account using google_drive.connect or auth.google_connect.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended shared account is available with explicit required Drive features.

What not to do

  • Do not expose credentials, content or resumable URLs.
  • Do not blindly repeat uncertain writes.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
